item.title: The Daily Spawn — Tuesday, October 6, 2026
item.description: Today's stories: Ninja Theory layoffs begin — closure looms; Star Wars: Galactic Racer launches — 88 Metacritic; Gears of War: E-Day is out today; Physical game sales hit a new low.

item.title: The Daily Spawn — Wednesday, October 7, 2026
item.description: Today's stories: Microsoft clarifies GTA 6 cloud streaming — and metered cloud hours; Forza Horizon 6 hits PlayStation 5 on January 26, 2027; Canceled Perfect Dark gameplay footage surfaces; Resident Evil Requiem writer slips DLC detail: Spencer's story continues.

item.title: The Daily Spawn — Thursday, October 8, 2026
item.description: Today's stories: Italy launches EU-backed probe into Microsoft gaming's virtual currencies; Xbox CEO: Project Helix is a family of devices — handheld hinted; Hellraiser: Revival launches today; reviews split from 9 to 6; Gravity Well layoffs vs Bit Reactor's rehiring.
